page.overview:
Who is Blizza?

Blizza is one of the snow spirits featured in the Adventure Tours mode of Mario & Sonic at the Olympic Winter Games for the Nintendo DS.

Blizza has the appearance of a large, levitating purple snowflake with black eyes.

Blizza is the snow spirit of Blizland. It is the sixth and final snow spirit found by both Mario and Sonic at Icepeak, when they meet up with Rouge, Dr. Eggman, and Bowser at the end. The two villains bribe Rogue with several Whitestones, and Dr. Eggman even strikes a deal that if Mario and Sonic's team wins against her in Figure Skating, he will release Blizza, whom he vaguely refers to as a snow spirit at first.

Even when the player's character wins against Rogue, Dr. Eggman and Bowser get frustrated and reluctantly free Blizza, who properly introduces himself to both Mario and Sonic. Releasing Blizza was a trick set up by both Dr. Eggman and Bowser, as they then decide to capture Frosty. Blizza joins the heroes, and they continue onward to Blizland. Here, Blizza can melt an ice wall if Mario and Sonic's team have four crystals.
